== Description ==

Players in the tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, including [[Justin Miyashiro]] (front left, black hoodie and glasses), [[Matt Thornton]] (centre-right, tan cap and black hoodie), [[Ryan Jellison]] (front right, cream long-sleeve shirt and glasses), and [[Karl Koenig]] (far right, red quarter-zip sweater); remaining faces unlabeled.
